text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 深棕细腰带。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: ONLY a narrow dark brown leather waist belt with a small metal buckle. The belt is detached, loosely arranged in an oval on a pure white background. Product photograph with realistic leather and soft shadow. Do NOT include any clothing or dress, body, skin, mannequin, shoes, jewelry or bag. One belt alone.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
